moves.name: Slow Push-In
moves.description: A gentle dolly drift from where the camera sits to about 2m off the subject — builds quiet intensity.

moves.name: Crash-In
moves.description: A fast push where most of the travel happens in the last third — a sudden lunge into the subject.

moves.name: Pull-Back Reveal
moves.description: Recede from the subject while rising slightly to reveal the surrounding context — a classic opener or closer.

moves.name: Creep-In Low
moves.description: A slow push at knee height that makes the subject loom — menacing, low-angle approach.

moves.name: Orbit 90° Left
moves.description: A quarter circle counter-clockwise around the subject at the current radius — reveals a new profile.

moves.name: Orbit 90° Right
moves.description: A quarter circle clockwise around the subject at the current radius — reveals the other profile.

moves.name: Orbit 180°
moves.description: A half circle around the subject, ending on the far side — a sweeping change of vantage.

moves.name: Orbit 360°
moves.description: A full circle around the subject, returning to the start azimuth — the hero-reveal spin.

moves.name: Arc & Push
moves.description: A quarter arc around the subject while the radius shrinks ~40% — orbits in and tightens at once.

moves.name: Orbit 45° Low
moves.description: A 45° arc around the subject at a low camera height (~0.5m) — a ground-level profile change looking up.

moves.name: Orbit 45° High
moves.description: A 45° arc around the subject raised ~4m above the start height, looking down — the high companion to Orbit 45° Low.

moves.name: Crane-Up Reveal
moves.description: Start at eye level, boom straight up to ~8m looking down as the world opens beneath the subject.

moves.name: Crane-Down Intro
moves.description: Descend from ~8m looking down to the subject at eye level — a graceful drop into the scene.

moves.name: Pedestal Up
moves.description: A straight vertical rise of ~3m holding aim on the subject — reframes head-to-toe without dolly.

moves.name: Boom Over
moves.description: Rise and pass directly overhead to the far side of the subject — a dramatic vault across.

moves.name: Spiral-In Descend
moves.description: Orbit ~180° while the radius tightens ~45% and the camera descends toward the subject’s eyeline — a closing spiral onto the face.

moves.name: Spiral-Out Ascend
moves.description: Orbit ~180° while the radius blooms ~1.8× and the camera rises ~4m — an opening spiral that reveals the surroundings.

moves.name: Pedestal Up (Slow)
moves.description: A gentle ~2m vertical rise holding aim on the subject — a softer, shorter boom than the standard pedestal.

moves.name: Drone Rise & Pull-Back
moves.description: Climb to ~15m while receding ~20m — the classic drone ending that lifts away from the subject.

moves.name: Flyover
moves.description: Pass directly over the subject from front to behind at ~12m — a sweeping aerial transit.

moves.name: Drone Orbit High
moves.description: A wide 270° orbit at ~10m altitude looking down — a soaring survey around the subject.

moves.name: Top-Down Descend
moves.description: A straight vertical drop from ~20m to ~6m looking straight down — a god’s-eye descent.

moves.name: Overhead Track-Follow
moves.description: Ride ~8m directly above the subject looking straight down and moving with it — a top-down following shot.

moves.name: Drone Strafe Reveal
moves.description: At ~10m altitude, strafe laterally ~20m across the subject’s flank while aiming at it — a sideways drone reveal.

moves.name: Follow Behind
moves.description: Ride ~4m behind the subject at ~1.8m, glued to its heading — the drone-chasing-a-plane shot.

moves.name: Lead the Subject
moves.description: Travel ~4m in front of the subject aiming back at it — leads the move and reads the face.

moves.name: Side-Track Left
moves.description: Travel alongside the subject ~4m off its left flank — a lateral tracking shot.

moves.name: Side-Track Right
moves.description: Travel alongside the subject ~4m off its right flank — a lateral tracking shot.

moves.name: Lead-Follow Front
moves.description: Travel ~4m directly in front of the subject facing back at it — a front-lead tracking shot that reads the face while leading the move.

moves.name: Low Lead Tilt-Up
moves.description: Lead the subject low to the ground (~0.4m) tilting up to meet it as it approaches — a heroic low-angle lead.

moves.name: Side-Dolly Past
moves.description: A lateral dolly ~4m off the subject’s flank that overtakes it — starts slightly behind, ends slightly ahead, aiming at it throughout.

moves.name: Static Pan Across
moves.description: Camera holds position and pans from 25° left of the subject to 25° right — surveys a line of action.

moves.name: Whip Pan
moves.description: Hold on the subject, then a violent 90° pan in ~0.4s mid-shot, then settle — a snappy scene cut.

moves.name: Slow Tilt Reveal
moves.description: Start tilted down at the ground before the subject, tilt up to meet their eyes — a reveal from the feet.

moves.name: Vertigo Dolly-Zoom
moves.description: Push in while the lens widens so the subject stays the same size — the disorienting Vertigo effect.

moves.name: Dutch Orbit
moves.description: A 90° orbit with the horizon rolling to a ±0.3rad dutch tilt — unsettling, stylized motion.

moves.name: Snap-Zoom Punch
moves.description: Static frame; the lens snaps 35→85mm over three tight marks mid-shot — a punch-in zoom accent.

moves.name: Crash-Zoom Out
moves.description: Static frame; the lens snaps 85→35mm over three tight marks mid-shot — a jarring pull-back zoom accent.

moves.name: Push-In Dutch Roll
moves.description: A slow push toward the subject while the horizon rolls into a ±0.3rad dutch tilt — mounting unease.
